status: exact normalization map of the published low-mass plateau; the full mass-dependent figure is not digitized

source.title: Short-Range, Spin-Dependent Interactions of Electrons: A Probe for Exotic Pseudo-Goldstone Bosons
source.authors: W. A. Terrano, E. G. Adelberger, J. G. Lee, and B. R. Heckel

normalization.terranoCoupling: g_p multiplies i phi bar(e) gamma_5 e and equals m_e/F in the pseudo-Goldstone convention
normalization.criticalTorsionCoupling: y_e=2m_e f_e multiplies -i phi bar(e) gamma_5 e
normalization.signQualification: the Terrano/Moody-Wilczek displayed potential has the opposite overall sign from the corrected Fadeev convention used in the programme; their magnitude-only exclusion is unchanged

translatedPlateau.B_over_CeSquared_scaling: 2.110060015362444e37*(30 microeV/m_phi)^2 within the published low-mass plateau

minimalDiracWitness.qualification: the delta bound applies only when the pole mass is inside the experimental plateau; m_phi^2=A/B correlates delta and B

comparison.interpretation: the idealized point-count witness is about 62 times stronger in coupling than the realized published plateau because it assumed larger effective coherent counts and a smaller torque threshold without apparatus geometry or backgrounds

decision: A real polarized-electron result now maps directly onto the critical torsion portal: for m_phi below 30 microeV, |y_e|<7.42e-9 and sqrt(A)/|c_e|>1.38e5 GeV. The experiment constrains only parameter combinations; it neither fixes c_e nor supplies a unique Spin(2,3) fingerprint.
